data.narrative:
Delian Alliance Industries is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $14M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, predominantly at Seed and Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $14M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $35M. The Peer-Median method isolates 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $700M, derived from a range of $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A). This dispersion reflects material heterogeneity in the peer set around technology differentiation and funding stage.

The triangulated valuation range is $30M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $368M. The wide spread reflects tension between the Stage-Progression anchor—conservative and capital-based—and the Peer-Median approach, which incorporates the full distribution of market outcomes in frontier defense tech. Key uncertainties include the applicability of later-stage Series A comparables to a Seed company, and whether peer valuations reflect comparable technology maturity or commercial traction. Resolution of these uncertainties requires clarity on Delian's specific technical differentiation and near-term revenue trajectory relative to the peer cohort.
